exposure: Timing of delivery (35 through 38 weeks gestation)
Delivery strategies (empiric steroids, steroids if FLM negative, wait a week and retest if FLM negative, deliver immediately)
outcome: Maternal and neonatal quality-adjusted life years (QALYs)
cohort: The study modeled outcomes for women with intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy (ICP).
finding: Immediate delivery at 36 weeks without fetal lung maturity (FLM) testing and steroid administration was identified as the optimal delivery strategy for women with ICP.
gest_age: Gestational ages from 34 to 40 weeks were considered for IUFD rates, and delivery strategies were compared for deliveries at 35 through 38 weeks gestation, with an optimal strategy identified at 36 weeks.
